topic: Where does inference for kernel tests, double-machine-learning causal intervals and Hawkes Granger tests break as memory grows, and does the break follow the H = 3/4 boundary in financial data? Sub-questions from proposals NEW-MB-KERNEL-G1-HSIC (HSIC null limit with general bounded kernels on each side of H_X+H_Y=3/2), G2-HFREE (projected or self-normalised kernel statistic valid across the 3/4 line without estimating H) and G3-RANK (asymmetric |x|-type or squared transforms and Hermite rank-2 protection on financial data).
